blocks.text: Why your sales pipeline management software feels slow

You likely use a complex web of tools. Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and various email sequences all fight for your attention. Each app requires a different workflow. You click, you type, and you search for the right field. This is where your day vanishes.
The hidden cost of context switching

When you jump from a browser tab in Chrome to a notes app or your email client, you lose momentum. Research shows that managing these transitions is a major productivity drain. You have to reorient yourself every time you switch. If you use 8 to 10 tools to close a single deal, those micro-delays add up.
How Lazur changes your workflow on Mac

Lazur is a voice assistant that sits in your Mac notch. It does not replace your sales pipeline management software. Instead, it acts as a bridge between your intent and your tools. When you need to find a specific deal stage or check a prospect's history, you hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask.
Researching leads without the tab clutter

Prospecting often involves opening dozens of tabs. You look at a company website, then LinkedIn, then your CRM. Lazur can help you manage this. Ask Lazur to research a company. It uses its own Chrome extension to gather information and provides a summary. This keeps your main browser window clean.
Drafting emails and notes with voice

Typing personalized outreach is slow. Hold the fn key to dictate your thoughts directly into Gmail or your outreach platform. Lazur formats your speech into clean, professional text. You can use your own snippets or dictionary. This is not just a dictation tool. It is a way to get your words on the screen without fighting the keyboard.
Common mistakes in sales pipeline management

items: Updating the CRM at the end of the day when details are fuzzy.
Keeping too many tabs open and losing track of which prospect is in which stage.
Manually copying and pasting data between LinkedIn and your CRM.
Ignoring the keyboard shortcuts that could save you seconds every time.
Trying to remember every detail instead of using a quick note-taking system.

blocks.text: What to do next to improve your sales performance

Start by identifying your biggest time sink. Is it the CRM? Is it email? Once you know, build a routine. Use keyboard shortcuts like ⌘ + L to jump to the address bar in Chrome. Use ⌘ + Space to open apps quickly. Then, add Lazur to your stack to handle the voice-based interactions. You do not need to change your entire process at once.

Your data is yours. Lazur only sees your screen and listens to your voice while you hold the shortcut keys. It does not store your audio or screenshots, and it never uses your content to train AI models. Always follow your company policy regarding client data and CRM security.
blocks.title: A note on security

faq.question: Does Lazur work with Salesforce or HubSpot?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any website or app on your Mac. It does not have a direct integration, but it can see your screen and answer questions about what is there, or guide you through UI steps.

faq.question: Can Lazur fill out my CRM forms?
faq.answer: Lazur does not click buttons or type into forms for you. It can guide you through the process or help you draft the text you need to enter.

faq.question: Is Lazur available on Windows?
faq.answer: No, Lazur is currently built only for macOS on Apple silicon and Intel chips.
